findings.highlight: She fought her battles until the very end, believing she was doing the right thing.
findings.evidenceJa: 最期に、己の信じた道が間違いではなかったと迎える為に、戦場を走り続けた。
findings.governingReading: She persevered so that at the end she could meet it knowing the chosen way was not mistaken.
findings.explanation: Fighting to meet death confident of her path becomes fighting while already believing it right.

findings.highlight: Even when she was told that everything she does would go unrewarded, she still wielded the sword and kept to her vow as king.
findings.evidenceJa: その最期が報われない物だと知らされても、なお剣を執り、王の誓いを守ったのだ。
findings.governingReading: She kept her vow despite being told the final end would not reward her.
findings.explanation: An unrewarded end becomes every action unrewarded.

findings.highlight: I can't do anything to tarnish the pride she held to until her final moments.
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくは死ぬ時まで続いたその誇りを、汚す事だけは、してはならない。
findings.governingReading: おそらく qualifies his account of how long the pride lasted.
findings.explanation: Pride probably lasting to death becomes unqualified final-moment pride.

findings.highlight: The mountain's summit has been blasted away, leaving only a smoldering wasteland behind.
findings.evidenceJa: 何もかも吹き飛んだ山頂は、まったいらな荒野に変わっていた。
findings.governingReading: Everything on the summit has been blown away, leaving a completely flat wasteland.
findings.explanation: The cleared summit's completely flat surface becomes a smoldering wasteland. The English adds burning and drops the stated shape of the remaining ground.
